## Decision Framework (reusable)
Domain-agnostic core: any caller passes `{ domain, subject, evidence[] }` and gets back a governed decision object (`judge_overall`, `judge_verdict`, `policy_approved`, `policy_violations`). Called from `10-f1-edge-flagship.json` via **Execute Sub-workflow**, once per Kalshi market.

### ① Agent reasoning (LLM)
The **AI Agent: Analyst** reads the evidence and returns a structured `{probability, reasoning, keyFactors}` assessment via a local Ollama model.

### ② LLM-as-judge (rubric)
A second, independent **AI Agent: Judge** scores that assessment 0–1 against a weighted rubric — no shared context with the analyst (`packages/core/src/judge.ts`).

### ③ Guardrail + policy gate
A **Code** node applies the rubric score + policy guardrails, then the **If** node branches to the decision (`packages/core/src/guardrail.ts`).

options.systemMessage: You are a careful analyst producing a probability assessment for a decision-support system. Respond with ONLY a single JSON object of the form {"probability": number between 0 and 1, "reasoning": string, "keyFactors": string[]}. Do not include any text outside the JSON object.

You are an impartial judge scoring an AI analyst's assessment against a rubric. Respond with ONLY a single JSON object of the form {"accuracy": <0-1>, "evidence_use": <0-1>, "calibration": <0-1>, "clarity": <0-1>, "critique": <string>}. Do not include any text outside the JSON object.
